title: Triple Zero
subtitle: Fortunately, we're a couple of expert firefighters.

trails.title: City Street Corner
trails.description: What took place on this street corner became the defining moment of the entire story. Sparks flew as the fires of youth met on this spot.

trails.title: Uluru Spring Source
trails.description: I know, I know—friction is inevitable. Conflict is the seed that sparks all growth.

trails.title: The Torch Guardians VI
trails.description: The torch relay comes to a halt here. The flickering flames have enraged the filth beneath the riverbed.

trails.title: End of Rumors
trails.description: The torch relay comes to a halt here. The spark has been ignited, and now a mouth spewing deceitful words opens, casting a veil over the eyes of all.

trails.title: A Box of Fake Tickets
trails.description: A divide still exists among the street gang on the issue of selling fake tickets.

content.text:
Counterfeit Ticket Seizure Information
January 17th, 1991

Eucalyptus Brotherhood: 65 Tickets Seized

January 19th, 1991

Slicky: 80 Tickets Seized

Slicky was also remarkably unprofessional in this instance. Did they really think that printing "Employee Ticket" directly on the front of their counterfeits would make people think they were actually real? Moreover, the workmanship is of laughable quality.

January 21st, 1991

Little Scissors Jerry: 240 Tickets Seized

An increasing number of fake tickets are floating around on the market, and all I can do is try my best to confiscate as many of them as I can to prevent them from making their way into the hands of unsuspecting spectators.

The gangs have already put a target on my back. I need to make sure I draw less attention to myself next time.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Good! You're doing great! Faster, higher!
A grandma can be crazy about sports too. Give her time, and she will burn like the sun.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Yes! Ulu, you are exactly the Ulu I knew in my memory!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Fire Racewalking, Apparate 400 Meters, Branch Vault, and Malingee's Harvest ... We have brought back so many old games!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Oh, I have to go! The Bunny Bunny Arm Wrestling is about to start!
Games after games, ideas after ideas.
Both active and inactive arcanists find their own happiness on this field.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: The people are having a good time here. They are sweaty but also delighted. I've never seen anything like this in Laplace.
Once again, Ezra looks up at the shabby rooftop.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: As Ms. Ulu said, this excitement comes from the Stadium itself. Is this a recovery arcane skill that works on arcanists? Or, a kind of cheering potion?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, I don't think so. It just smells ... familiar here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Yes! Right! Totally agree with you!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It smells like the, uh, the weird cave on that island ... burp! Hmm?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, I smell beef, with tomato and mixed grilling sauce ... Oh! It must be my tomato steak flavor potato crisp. Haha! This is great fun!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I didn't touch a drop, but, ah, feeling dizzy!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Watch out, Regulus. You are falling down.
Supported by a pair of friendly arms, the Rockin' Pirate softly jumps like a long, thin jelly.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh? Are you saying that a sports game can narcotize people, too? Hmm. I think Mr. APPLe knows it better than me. Let me check where he is.
Despite her weakness, the pirate's excitement is not dampened. She's in a "jelly" mood to explore.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mmm?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I see him! I see a red ball. Oh! That must be Mr. APPLe! But, but he seems rounder and bigger.
While Vertin is trying to keep a drunk Regulus balanced, the game on the other side of the Stadium has come to an end. Spathodea wipes the sweat off her forehead with rosy cheeks and eyes sparkling.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Time's up! And the victory goes to—Ms. Desert Flannel!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Ha ...! I told ya, no one beats me at arm-wrestling!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: *pants* Ugh, I lost ... You are so strong!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The strongest I have ever ... Ugh ...
Spathodea bounces up like a spring.
And immediately slumps down.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Spathodea!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: You alright? Hey ... wake up! Go, get me the wet towel!
Folding the towel and putting it on that rosy girl's forehead has become a routine to Desert Flannel. After finishing this, she fans her with her own jacket.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Her temperature ... is a bit lower than just now, but her condition is quite stable. I guess it's not a "reincarnator" reaction, but something else.

items.speaker: Darley Clatter
items.text: *sniff*

items.speaker: Darley Clatter
items.text: Is she alright? She feels hot, but not as hot as the horseshoe made of pure gold.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I'm positive that she was once a lot hotter than your little hooves are right now.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: She was a walking fire that burned fiercely, the forest-destroying kind.

items.speaker: Darley Clatter
items.text: Neigh?!
The wooden horse whinnies in panic and rolls backward on its squeaky metal wheels.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Please don't panic. I have not observed any signs of flame in her eyes or mouth. She's not ablaze again.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms. Desert Flannel, did she have any abnormalities before she passed out?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Abnormalities? Some, I think. She waddled as if she was pissed, and talked so loudly that anyone could tell she wasn't in a clear mind ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Drunk, clouding of consciousness ... No, Regulus!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You look like an apple-color giant rock, Mr. APPLe! You are so big, and our ship is so small.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: I'm feeling so good ... and inspired! *deep breath*
Standing next to a tremendous ball of fire, the Rockin' Pirate has never felt this small before.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *exhales* Ah? Huh? Seems your change of size changes your voice as well.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But! Since you get this huge, we can strike those old fogeys in London like a meteor! On top of the world, there will be our flag of Rock 'n' Roll!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come! Come to me—I require the biggest huuuuug!
But it's not a good idea to have any hugs with fire.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoaa!! It's hot! It's burning!! It's burning my hands!
Because they are scorching, unstable, and fiery.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Go beyond your limits! Your sweat is the best eulogy for the red land!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: That's Ms. Ulu! She's out of control! Is this ... Also a result of the Stadium's power?!

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Oh, my! Ms. Regulus! Be careful!
The fireball grows bigger and bigger. Bunny Bunny runs to Regulus and grabs her sleeve.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah, I'm so tired. Let me take a nap.

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Regulus? Regulus! Oh, dear ... Don't pass out now! I'm getting you outta here, just a sec!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Zzzz ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Another one has passed out. If we let it go on like this, every arcanist here would ... Ms. Vertin, we have to leave at once!

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: But Ms. Spathodea has passed out, too! Who can open that door?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Bunny Bunny, take everyone back to the suitcase!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't let anyone out before I open it again!

items.speaker: Bunny Bunny
items.text: Alright, got it ... Oops! I got tripped by ... Huh?! Mr. APPLe! Why are you sleeping in the grass?

items.speaker: Darley Clatter
items.text: Darley is on it!

With Click on his back and APPLe in his mouth, Darley Clatter pushes La Source into the suitcase and jumps inside after her. Clang. The suitcase closes, blocking the fire from a full room of arcanists.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: All the fun, the fun of sports! I am burning like I did a thousand years ago!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Haha ... Let's dance hand in hand, for the respectable sunshine ... and rain!
Fire is always scorching, not to mention the Uluru Flame which has been burning for a thousand years.
She emits her heat like she did as a newborn baby. Smoke coming billowing from the soil, even the beast bones inside eventually burn.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Mmm. This is too dangerous. She may start a fire!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have to put her out for now.
Ezra turns to Vertin. They both remember what happened that night at the park.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... The good news is, we are already a skilled fire brigade.
